ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity dark pixels across the visible surface with localized high-intensity white linear features; estimated ratio of 15:1 dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across both lobes; presence of high-contrast white linear filaments concentrated on the right lobe and a dense white pixel cluster at the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern on the right lobe featuring multiple sharp peaks and shallow valleys; left lobe exhibits similar jagged topography but is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the posterior margins of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-intensity white circular pixels at the distal apex of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across the right lobe; sparse linear marks also visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white linear rake marks across the surface of both lobes; irregular white scarring/pigmentation at the tip of the right lobe.
